_comment: Tier-2 for febio::viscoelasticity#0. The shipped DYNAMIC step-loaded relaxation deck flips the sign of its logged sz on nearly every step and its peak |sz| exceeds its final |sz| — the amplitude does not decay. The same deck under STATIC gives ZERO sign changes and a final stress of the correct compressive sign. Refining the step tenfold makes both the peak and the sign-change count WORSE, which is what rules out step-size convergence error. All three runs reach normal termination with exit 0, so the banner tells you nothing. Counts and peaks are computed by the fixture; no number is carried in the catalogue text. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'relaxation_ringing=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
